title: Independently verify #4610’s conditional κ gain over selected #4470
body:
This adds independent conditional admission evidence for Cao Yifan/intqwq's already merged #4610 construction. It closes the audit's remaining helper/paid absolute-phase coverage and catalogue-specialization obligations, with a registered cold replay that checks the complete construction. The construction and numerical improvement retain their original authorship.

| Quantity | Exact value |
| --- | --- |
| Selected #4470 κ | `60403/20000000 = 0.00302015` |
| Existing #4610 κ verified here | `15108879/5000000000 = 0.0030217758` |
| Gain over selected | `8129/5000000000 = 0.0000016258` |

The result is conditional `O(n (log n)^(1-κ))` under **exactly the five selected #4470 assumption records**. The package supplies a source-specific specialization argument for the fixed catalogue. It does not propose a new construction, improve on #4610 itself, edit the selected result, or claim an unconditional/end-to-end Lean theorem or measured practical speedup.

The additive package is `research/final4610-independent-admission/`. Its 11-stage default replay checks:

- All 180 signed native phase classes, all 408 helpers in both orientations (34 classes), and all 5,710 actual oriented paid classes covering 6,596 paid event instances.
- Both orientations of the word on 632 arbitrary persistent inputs, owned-center restoration, and the algebraic all-positive-column/free-group lift.
- The complete controller invoice: 64,404 paid calls, 10,928 productive fields and rank-mass surplus 752; two directed interval engines; charged completion/tails; compiler capacity; 54 strict and four functional outer guards.
- Working-byte/source-history bindings, unchanged selected assumptions, displayed claim identity, fresh-invoice dependence, and semantic rejection controls. Recipe generation is separate from independent phase verification.

Validation on Python 3.12.3:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/final4610-independent-admission --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/final4610-independent-admission
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/final4610-independent-admission --check-source-history
```

All passed. The final registered complete replay took **114.98 s guarded wall time**, with **157.1 MiB sampled peak descendant RSS**, under a serial 660 s / 1 GiB research guard. It ran on local commit `310f3a09408cd42d49e8e279fae14f0fbb5af94b`; published commit `13efb5fc5f3b7c14ec2cfa181dd9eb6480972cf2` has the **identical entire Git tree** `bd98fae7d53b31d5c549e13f50c201ae7d92573d` and upstream parent `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`. A fresh checkout of that published commit passed metadata, all 82 package/input committed-byte comparisons, canonical source-history checks and claim/source preflight. Hosted CI is a separate gate; local success is not labelled hosted success.

`FIRST-COLD-REPLAY.json` preserves the earlier detailed complete mathematical receipt. Its draft-era presentation metadata is retained honestly. The subsequent identity/scope fix changed no previously executed mathematical checker; the final registered replay reran every stage after that fix. `VALIDATION.json` explains this boundary and the external final-head receipt policy.

Scientific inputs are pinned to canonical ancestor `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c`; all 51 are byte-identical at the refreshed base. Original #4610 head: `20bb93cd990d2ff683e4d0fc56b87a42cd5d3296`; word payload SHA256: `cfcd36b40326d7a5815e1db5313444379b3fb756b27d5201c561574c085cc0dd`. Existing sources, archives and selection are unchanged. A final live PR/discussion overlap check found no conflicting public update as of 2026-10-23 13:37 UTC; unpublished activity is unknown.

This is a refined independent admission/verification scope after the swarm's new-profile search found no winning construction. TASK.json retains the assigned source card and open questions. It is not an unchanged-root hill-climbing claim: the verified gain is #4610's existing changed complete profile relative to selected #4470.

Credit: Cao Yifan/intqwq (#4610); Cinna Davis/1337isnot1337 (#4470 and controller/helper lineage); Dugongue, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman, icekylinx, and retained native/Clifford/geometry/BIT/precision/analytic/recovery contributors. New audit code and independent reviews were produced with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance using a gpt-6.1-sol high swarm. These are independent AI checks, not human or proof-kernel acceptance. Apache-2.0; predecessor notices retained.

Open next questions, relevance and first steps are in TASK.json and README.md. Formalizing the inherited physical execution and analytic framework would support stronger future claims; it is not silently added as a new premise here.
